facts.what: 听完判决后掐喉咙、喉结滚动、起身要水
厨房呛水、心跳失控，把双腕浸入冰水后缓解
facts.anchor: Plunging both my wrists under the icy water that’s still running, I hold them there, despite the sting.

facts.what: 自知谎言已毁道德，但怕他脾气、决定继续演到底
facts.anchor: I’ve just blown my morals to smithereens, but I don’t know how he’ll react when I tell him that I made it all up.

facts.what: 回房后已平静坐下、像什么都没发生；接过水一饮而尽
facts.anchor: he’s sitting down again, patiently waiting for my return as if I’d just nipped to the loo and nothing more

facts.what: 正式告知「你女友已不在我们中间」，自称是他的 loss
facts.anchor: ‘I am very sorry for your loss. You were right, your girlfriend is unfortunately no longer with us.’

facts.what: 雷雨砸窗；她看见他的眼睛不像他的
facts.anchor: Because the eyes I’m looking into don’t belong to him.

facts.what: 暴风雨前屋内两人，如今他肩后多出一个女人，共三人
facts.anchor: Before the storm, there were just two people in this room – and now, including the woman standing behind his shoulder, there are three.

relations: Cassie 向 Finlay 宣告其女友死亡；她看见他身后有女人显形
